## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3 and 6: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, and
`ocr/06/articles-report.md` for `folded`. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 12 specifics

- Located 96.9% (14.3% by fuzzy match), label + body 91.7%, analysis 80.6%.
- **Against the typed witnesses** (`docs/witness-join.md`, `docs/witness-pndaza.md`): labels agree on 98.7% of 6,444 rows where both have one; analyses are ≥ 0.8 / < 0.4 similar in 97.2% / 0.2%. Pn Daza's page-referenced copy gives a typed text for 220 of the articles the OCR could not place.
- With 14/1 and 19 among the best of the batch: 94.0% verbatim, 96.9% located, 91.7% with label and body; its gutters at ≥ 0.54 (3 pages) read normally.

## Spot check

One page, p. 589 (a page near the middle of the book with 9–14 headwords): 9 of 9; labels 9, all as the witness.
Checked in the text (each placed row opens on its headword, with its label) and against the typed witness page by page; the image was not opened.
For this batch the spot check is one page per book, not three: vols. 10–19 are checked page by page against the typed witness instead, and the three books without one (14/3, 20, 22) on the image.
